subject: [RFC PATCH 6/7] memcg: charge high_work reclaim to the memcg

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of high_work reclaim in the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) subsystem. When a memcg exceeds its memory.high limit, the reclaim process is currently run from a kworker thread in the root cgroup, which means it doesn't get charged to the memcg's cpu.stat or memory.pressure metrics and doesn't count against its cpu.max quota. This patch changes the reclaim process to run under set_active_cgroup(), which charges its CPU time and memory stalls to the memcg's cgroup and deducts from its cpu.max quota, providing a more accurate representation of the memcg's resource usage.
